Pumpkin Doughnut

🍂 Autumn Harvest
Start Baking
0 substitutions applied Share this version

Ingredients

Doughnuts

  • 2 c all-purpose flour
    Swap: 2 c gluten-free 1-to-1 baking flour Use this for a gluten-free version — jared
  • 2 tsp pumpkin pie spice
  • 2 tsp baking powder
  • 1 tsp kosher salt
  • 1 can (15 oz) pumpkin puree
  • 1 1/2 c sugar
  • 1/3 c vegetable oil
  • 4 tbsp unsalted butter, melted
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 3 lg eggs

Topping

  • 3/4 c sugar
  • 2 tsp ground cinnamon
  • 3 tbsp unsalted butter, melted

Directions

Tap a step to cross it off.

  6. Bake doughnuts about 15 minutes. Check with toothpick.
    💡 Tip
    Gluten-free batter may need 2-3 extra minutes. Look for golden edges and a clean toothpick. — jared

Michelle Weinfeld-Geller, Michigan

Pumpkin spice season is coming.

Our family really loves doughnuts! With it being fall, I needed to find a pumpkin recipe. I found the directions easy to follow and they came out delicious! This recipe is a keeper!
